title: Extractor suffix copying
statement: Let $x$, $r$, and $a$ be Boolean words, write $x=p r$, and let $o$ be a Boolean output word. For either choice of the first flag, the pair extractor with its second flag true, started in suffix state with input head just past $p$, buffer $a$, work head at $|a|$, and output $o$, reaches after exactly $|r|+1$ steps the halted configuration with input head at the end of $x$, the same buffer and work head, and output $o$ followed by $r$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean words x, r, and a
A prefix p with x = p ++ r
replaced:
With the second-component flag set and a split $x = p s$ of the input, from
the extractor's suffix state at position $\abs{p}$ with buffer $a$ and prior
output $o$, exactly $\abs{s}+1$ steps reach a halted configuration with output
$o$ followed by $s$; the buffer and its head are untouched.
